title: Palorder central (PC)
description: A dynamic and engaging Minecraft server inspired by the fast paced and feature rich style of netherite.gg designed to provide a balanced mix of competition creativity and progression it offers multiple gamemodes in one cohesive experience players can enjoy
body:
## Server Overview

A multi-gamemode Minecraft server offering a range of unique experiences:

### Lifesteal

A high-risk survival mode where defeating other players grants you their hearts.

### Creative

Powered by the OpenCreative+ plugin, providing advanced building tools and enhanced creative features.

### Survival (SMP) — Most Active

Our primary and most active gamemode, frequently played by staff, including the owner.

* Built on Fabric for improved performance
* Includes optimizations such as Lithium
* Features a custom-integrated economy system using a modified version of EconomyCraft
* Custom mod available here:
  https://modrinth.com/mod/brokenstarsmp-official-mod

Note: This gamemode is modded but can still be played using a vanilla client.

### PvP (In Development)

An unfinished gamemode as of 2 April 2026.

* Currently has no spawn implemented
* Inspired by classic MCPvP tier-based combat systems
* Development is ongoing while searching for a suitable dueling plugin or equivalent system

### Skyblock (Upcoming)

Planned for release after PvP is completed. Development is currently on hold pending PvP system improvements.
